fine_lines.title: want vs I'll have
fine_lines.explanation_ar: I want صحيحة لكنها مباشرة جدًا عند الطلب في مطعم. الطريقة المهذّبة المعتادة: I'll have ..., please أو I'd like ..., please. في الدرس قال Jonathan: I'll have the shrimp، بينما قالت Anna: I want the chicken dish.
fine_lines.explanation_en: I want is correct but very direct when you order food. It is more polite to say I'll have ..., please or I'd like ..., please. Jonathan says 'I'll have the shrimp.'

examples.sentence: I want to visit Peru one day.
I'll have a cup of tea, please.

fine_lines.title: dessert vs desert
fine_lines.explanation_ar: dessert (بحرفي s) هي الحلوى بعد الطعام والنبر على المقطع الثاني: dih-ZURT. أما desert (بحرف s واحد) فهي الصحراء والنبر على المقطع الأول: DEZ-ert.
fine_lines.explanation_en: dessert (double s) is the sweet food after a meal: dih-ZURT. desert (one s) is a dry, sandy land: DEZ-ert.

examples.sentence: It is very hot in the desert.

grammar.title: want + noun / want to + verb
grammar.explanation_ar: 1) want + اسم: I want chicken. 2) want + to + فعل أصلي: I want to visit Peru. 3) مع he/she/it نضيف s: She wants dessert. 4) السؤال: What do you want? / What does she want? 5) النفي: I don't want ... / He doesn't want ...
grammar.explanation_en: 1) want + noun: I want chicken. 2) want + to + base verb: I want to visit Peru. 3) With he/she/it add -s: She wants dessert. 4) Questions: What do you want? / What does she want? 5) Negative: I don't want... / He doesn't want...
examples: What country do you want to visit?

grammar.title: Ordering food politely
grammar.explanation_ar: عند الطلب في المطعم نقول: I'll have + الطعام (+ please). وإذا نفد شيء يقول البائع: We're out of ... فتقول: Okay, I'll have ... then. ولسؤال السعر: How much is it? / How much does it cost?
grammar.explanation_en: To order food, say I'll have + the food (+ please). If something is finished, the worker says We're out of ... and you can say Okay, I'll have ... then. To ask the price: How much is it? / How much does it cost?
examples: How much does the dish cost?

grammar.title: Telling the time and money
grammar.explanation_ar: 11:50 نقرأها eleven fifty، و12:00 ظهرًا noon. نكتب $10 ونقرأ ten dollars (علامة الدولار تُكتب قبل الرقم وتُقرأ بعده). ولحساب الباقي: The dish is $7, so here is $3 back.
grammar.explanation_en: Say 11:50 as 'eleven fifty'; 12:00 in the day is noon. Write $10, but say 'ten dollars' (the sign comes first, but you say it after the number). Change: The dish is $7, so here is $3 back.
